video-to-mp3/features/browser_based: Browser-based — all processing happens locally, no upload needed
video-to-mp3/features/dual_engine: Dual engine — lightweight mode for small files, ffmpeg.wasm for larger ones
video-to-mp3/features/fast_small: Fast conversion for small files using browser's native audio decoder
video-to-mp3/features/multi_format: Multi-format support — MP4, WebM, AVI, MOV, MKV, and more
video-to-mp3/features/privacy_first: Privacy first — your files never leave your device
video-to-mp3/how_to_use/step1: Click the upload area and select a video file from your device
video-to-mp3/how_to_use/step2: Preview the video and check its duration
video-to-mp3/how_to_use/step3: Click "Convert to MP3" and wait for processing to complete
video-to-mp3/message/error: An error occurred while processing the video
video-to-mp3/message/no_audio: This video does not contain an audio track, so it cannot be converted to MP3
video-to-mp3/message/preview_error: Your browser cannot preview this video format, but conversion should still work.
video-to-mp3/note: Extract audio from video and convert to MP3 format, right in your browser.
